title: Injective acyclicity gives sheaf-level base change for arbitrary coefficients
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Assume that $f$ has injective acyclicity over $\Lambda$: for every morphism $g:Y'\to Y$, every cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with induced $f':X'\to Y'$ and $g':X'\to X$, and every injective sheaf $I$ of $\Lambda_X$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ whose underlying abelian sheaf is torsion [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf], one has $R^qf'_*g'^{-1}I=0$ for all $q>0$ (higher direct images [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] of the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] of the underlying abelian sheaf). Then for every such square and every sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda_X$-modules with torsion underlying abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$, regarded as a complex concentrated in degree $0$, the derived exchange morphism $\Ex_{\square,F}:g^{-1}Rf_*F\to Rf'_*g'^{-1}F$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] is an isomorphism in $\Dplus(Y'_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].
